name: @miftachurrochim82/frontend-cdn
description: Shared Frontend Assets CDN untuk aplikasi web Google Apps Script Pemkab Trenggalek

scripts.build:js: terser frontend/app-core.js -c -m -o frontend/app-core.min.js && terser frontend/app-components.js -c -m -o frontend/app-components.min.js && terser frontend/app-modules.js -c -m -o frontend/app-modules.min.js && terser frontend/app-layout.js -c -m -o frontend/app-layout.min.js && terser frontend/app-ui.js -c -m -o frontend/app-ui.min.js && terser frontend/app-forms.js -c -m -o frontend/app-forms.min.js && terser frontend/app-data.js -c -m -o frontend/app-data.min.js && terser frontend/app-charts.js -c -m -o frontend/app-charts.min.js && terser frontend/app-workflow.js -c -m -o frontend/app-workflow.min.js
scripts.build: npm run build:js && npm run build:css
